title: Spotify hits 83M paying subscribers, more than double Apple Music’s 40M
text: Spotify hits 83M paying subscribers, more than double Apple Music’s 40M Thursday, 26 July 2018 ( 2 hours ago ) Spotify has announced that its paid subscribers rose 10% during Q2 to hit 83M. This is 8M up from the 75M it had at the beginning of the year … more… Spotify is racing to sign up users before Apple Music can, even at the expense of its finances.
